LanguageData.LP_CloudMistyStep.label: misty step
LanguageData.LP_CloudMistyStep.description: Turn into a wisp of silver mist and instantly appear in a visible empty spot within 6 cells. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_CloudFog.label: fog cloud
LanguageData.LP_CloudFog.description: Summon a thick fog at the target point: blinding smoke in a 4-cell radius for 30 seconds (blocks line of sight for shooting). Cooldown 4 hours.
LanguageData.LP_CloudCallWind.label: call wind, drive clouds
LanguageData.LP_CloudCallWind.description: (Adult) After casting, choose a weather: clear, fog or rain; the map's weather changes to it and holds for 1 day. Cannot call thunderstorms. Cooldown 5 days (refunded if you close the choice menu without picking).
